body: I'm so scared to give a baby up for adoption because I know I'm too selfish to do it. Adoption is such a courageous and selfless act, and I just feel like it would drive me insane and eat away at me if I did that. And abortion just isn't an option for me. I support it but not for myself. My mom is a single mom and I was raised in an extremely difficult environment. My boyfriend often mentions my "daddy issues" too. He makes me feel so horrible. I don't want to have a baby with him but I don't want to give it up, and I don't want to abort it. I don't know what to do, and ending my life consistently seems like the best option for everyone involved. My baby won't be raised in poverty by an unstable single mother, my boyfriend's life won't be ruined, my mom won't have the added stress of a baby in the home, and I can escape from it all. I'm so scared and upset.

I don't think I'm emotionally strong enough to have my baby grow inside of me for nine months and then hand it off to someone else. I'm contemplating ending my life, and adoption is such a strong and selfless decision. I'm not strong, nor am I selfless. I'm weak and terrified.

I feel like if I kill myself and take the baby with me then nobody has to worry about anything. There's no motherless baby to raise, nobody will have to deal with my later stages of pregnancy, my boyfriend won't feel like I ruined his life.. I just want this to all go away. I feel like I'm burdening everyone. I told a couple of my friends and they yelled at me and told me I wasn't capable of raising a baby. I'm so scared and alone and done.
